definitions.explanation: Formally refusing to acknowledge or accept something as true. Commonly used in legal, political, and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {容疑|ようぎ}を{否認|ひにん}する。
{被告|ひこく}は{関与|かんよ}を{否認|ひにん}した。
{政府|せいふ}は{報道|ほうどう}の{内容|ないよう}を{全面的|ぜんめんてき}に{否認|ひにん}した。
examples.english: The government completely denied the contents of the news report.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{容疑|ようぎ}を{否認|ひにん}する (deny allegations/charges)
・{関与|かんよ}を{否認|ひにん}する (deny involvement)
・{全面|ぜんめん}{否認|ひにん} (complete denial)
・{事実|じじつ}を{否認|ひにん}する (deny the facts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{否定|ひてい} (denial, negation) is a broader term — you can deny facts, ideas, or existence. {否認|ひにん} is more specific and formal, typically used for denying accusations, charges, or responsibility. In legal contexts, {否認|ひにん} is the standard term for a defendant's denial of charges.
